reviews.title: Can’t Rearrange the Order of Tasks
reviews.text: They need to add the ability to tap and hold to drag tasks in the correct order. Or at the very least put them in the correct order based on the time they are set to be done. I need my morning tasks up top. Otherwise, I like the app. The design is cute. I like the program recommendations as well with example tasks. I hope they continue adding to that. But until I can rearrange the tasks, for me personally I can’t really use it unless I go the long route of updating each task (since that moves it to the top) in a specific order so my tasks are aligned properly. But that’s a lot to do.
